messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch that info. We cannot actually fetch from the internet. But we can provide a list based on known Canadian public holidays that create long weekends. We need to list the long weekends: typically holidays that fall on Friday or Monday, or holidays that create a 3-day weekend. Also some holidays that are observed on nearest weekday if they fall on weekend. For Canada, federal holidays: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (varies by province), Good Friday (variable), Victoria Day (May 24), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (first Monday in September), Thanksgiving (second Monday in October), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas Day (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). But long weekends: New Year's Day (if Jan 1 is a Sunday, observed Monday Jan 2). In 2023, Jan 1 is Sunday, so observed Monday Jan 2. That creates a long weekend Jan 1-3? Actually Jan 1 is Sunday, Jan 2 Monday observed, Jan 3 Tuesday. So weekend is Jan 1-2. That's a 2-day weekend. But long weekend maybe considered 3 days if holiday falls on Friday or Monday. Let's list all holidays that create a 3-day weekend:

- New Year's Day: 2023 Jan 1 Sunday, observed Monday Jan 2. So weekend Jan 1-2 (2 days). Not a long weekend? Some consider it a long weekend because you get 3 days off (Fri Dec 30, Sat Dec 31, Sun Jan 1). But the holiday is on Sunday, but you get Monday off. So you have 3 days off: Fri, Sat, Sun. So yes.

- Family Day: In many provinces (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) on third Monday in February. In 2023, Family Day was Feb 20 (Monday). So long weekend Feb 18-20 (Fri-Sun). So yes.

- Good Friday: 2023 Good Friday is April 7 (Friday). So long weekend Apr 7-9 (Fri-Sun). Yes.

- Victoria Day: 2023 May 22 (Monday). Long weekend May 20-22 (Fri-Sun). Yes.

- Canada Day: July 1 2023 is Saturday. Observed on Monday July 3. So long weekend July 1-3 (Sat-Mon). Yes.

- Labour Day: Sept 4 2023 (Monday). Long weekend Sep 2-4 (Fri-Sun). Yes.

- Thanksgiving: Oct 9 2023 (Monday). Long weekend Oct 7-9 (Fri-Sun). Yes.

- Remembrance Day: Nov 11 2023 (Saturday). Observed on Monday Nov 13. So long weekend Nov 11-13 (Sat-Mon). Yes.

- Christmas Day: Dec 25 2023 (Monday). Long weekend Dec 23-25 (Fri-Sun). Yes.

- Boxing Day: Dec 26 2023 (Tuesday). Not a long weekend unless you take adjacent days. But it's a holiday on Tuesday, so not a long weekend.

Also some provinces have other holidays like St. Patrick's Day (Ontario) on March 17, but not a long weekend.

Also some provinces have "St. Patrick's Day" as a holiday in Ontario, but it's on March 17 2023 (Friday). That would create a long weekend March 17-19 (Fri-Sun). But it's only a provincial holiday. The user didn't specify province. They want Canada-wide. So we might list federal holidays that create long weekends. But we could mention that some provinces have additional long weekends.
